info.title: attendance-administration
info.description: Collect RSVPs, check people in and see attendance by group – for rehearsals, trainings and meetings, all on your own server

get.description:
Returns admin-editable configuration, computed status, and available groups. System-wide capabilities (teamsAvailable, calendarSyncAvailable, notificationsAppEnabled) are available via GET /api/capabilities.
This endpoint requires admin access

allowMaybe.description: Whether appointments offer "Maybe" where they have no override of their own

selfCheckinWindowMinutes.description: Minutes before appointment start that self-check-in opens

onboardingCompleted.description: Whether the setup wizard has been walked to its end
